title: OmniDrive: A Holistic Vision-Language Dataset for Autonomous Driving with Counterfactual Reasoning
authors: Shihao Wang;Zhiding Yu;Xiaohui Jiang;Shiyi Lan;Min Shi;Nadine Chang;Jan Kautz;Ying Li;Jose M. Alvarez
topics: VLM;LLM;3D Grounding;Counterfactual Reasoning;Planning Interface;Open-loop Evaluation;Data Generation
takeaway: OmniDrive 用轨迹反事实把 3D 场景、语言推理和规划监督连起来；但更好的开放环指标仍可能来自 ego-status 捷径，且反事实没有模拟其他交通参与者的响应。

title: Occupancy Learning with Spatiotemporal Memory
verification_stage: 论文、补充材料与官方源码已审
takeaway: ST-Occ 用场景坐标中的持久 3D 记忆提升 Occupancy 精度与时间一致性，但证据仍局限于单一数据域，且源码中的状态更新比论文示意更复杂。

title: VoxelNeXt: Fully Sparse VoxelNet for 3D Object Detection and Tracking
authors: Yukang Chen;Jianhui Liu;Xiangyu Zhang;Xiaojuan Qi;Jiaya Jia
topics: 3D Object Detection;3D Multi-Object Tracking;Sparse Convolution;Voxel Representation;Efficient Inference;Post-processing
verification_stage: 论文、补充材料与官方源码已审
takeaway: VoxelNeXt 证明非中心稀疏体素也能直接回归三维框并改善速度—精度折中；但官方默认配置仍使用 NMS、未启用剪枝，跟踪关联代码也未发布。

title: BEVFormer: Learning Bird’s-Eye-View Representation from Multi-Camera Images via Spatiotemporal Transformers
authors: Zhiqi Li;Wenhai Wang;Hongyang Li;Enze Xie;Chonghao Sima;Tong Lu;Yu Qiao;Jifeng Dai
topics: Bird's-Eye View;3D Object Detection;Map Segmentation;Spatial Cross-Attention;Temporal Memory;Deformable Attention;Multi-Task Perception;Camera Calibration
verification_stage: 论文、补充材料与官方源码已审
takeaway: BEVFormer 用标定约束的空间交叉注意力和递归历史 BEV 把六路相机变成统一时空 BEV；但固定公开提交只闭环检测、未发布地图分割，且时序状态与标定误差的长序列耦合未验证。
